jobs.title: Design codex — RFC 0051 V1 auto-finalize integration point
jobs.objective: Design the runner-side auto-finalize feature per RFC 0051 §Design. For each of: (a) the periodic reconciliation hook (where in src/striatum/ does the lease-tick scan run? candidates: src/striatum/recovery/watch.py, src/striatum/recovery/auto.py, a new src/striatum/auto_finalize.py module, or in-process inside heartbeat); (b) the per-session artifact check sequence (resolve session's current expected_artifacts → for each declared path: exists() / parse frontmatter / validate against kind's V1 schema / byline equals expected_author_line); (c) the internal auto-publish + auto-verdict + auto-complete sequence (must be atomic per session — single PG transaction); (d) the two new event types' payload shape per RFC §Audit markers; (e) the STRIATUM_AUTO_FINALIZE_ENABLE feature-flag plumbing; (f) the refusal-path mapping (malformed FM → fall through; byline mismatch → fall through; missing artifact → fall through; lease unhealthy → skip). Cite existing helpers reused: complete_inline, ack_inline, publish_artifact_pg (already exported per dogfood-058 / RFC 0048 V1.5 HIGH#2). Anti-race: mtime > 10s before parsing (RFC §Trigger). Test surfaces: 4 regression tests per RFC §Acceptance.

jobs.title: Design claude — RFC 0051 V1 auto-finalize integration point

Synth codex — RFC 0051 V1 single-track lock
jobs.objective: Reconcile the 3 designs into one concrete plan. Lock: (1) the reconciliation hook module + function signature (single answer, not a menu); (2) per-method internal call sequence (specific function names already exported); (3) two new event payload shapes; (4) feature-flag check point; (5) 4 acceptance tests with exact file paths. NO dual-track — auto-finalize is single-cohesive feature. The 058 dual-track lesson applies.

jobs.title: Review design claude ergonomics_dx
jobs.objective: Review synthesis. Mandatory checks: (1) reconciliation hook is a single named module + function — bounce on menu; (2) atomic transaction discipline — publish/verdict/complete must run inside one conn.transaction(); (3) feature-flag check is at the hook entry, not buried in the publish helper; (4) audit markers cite RFC 0051 §Distinct from operator-on-behalf — `lane_finalization=auto_from_artifact`; (5) all 4 acceptance tests named with concrete fixture paths. Ergonomics_dx: failure-path operator visibility — when auto-finalize is skipped, the existing lane-stall blocker must still surface with the same hint so the operator path stays unchanged.

jobs.title: Implement RFC 0051 V1 auto-finalize (codex, single track)
jobs.objective: Implement per the synthesis. Sub-agents per cluster (no dual-track): (1) the reconciliation hook + per-session scan, (2) the internal publish/verdict/complete sequence (composed from complete_inline/ack_inline/publish_artifact_pg), (3) two new event types + their audit-payload writers, (4) feature-flag plumbing (STRIATUM_AUTO_FINALIZE_ENABLE). Tests under tests/test_auto_finalize.py: (a) disk artifact exists + valid → auto-finalize fires, job state transitions through expected sequence; (b) byline mismatch → fall through, lane-stall blocker visible; (c) malformed frontmatter → fall through; (d) feature flag off → no scan runs.

jobs.title: Build review codex threat_model
jobs.objective: Threat model: (1) auto-finalize never advances a job whose byline doesn't match expected_author_line; (2) the parse step rejects YAML / JSON injection attempts in frontmatter without raising — falls through to lane-stall; (3) the auto-publish writes the lane_finalization=auto_from_artifact marker so audit can distinguish from agent/operator path; (4) the feature flag check is at hook entry (operator opt-in V1); (5) tests assert capability_token discipline — auto-finalize doesn't bypass authorization (it uses an internal capability path that's still audit-chained).

jobs.title: Build review claude ergonomics_dx
jobs.objective: Operator UX: when auto-finalize fires, the existing dashboard shows the job state transitioning normally (no special 'auto' badge required in V1; that's V1.1 polish); when it doesn't fire (byline mismatch, etc.), the dashboard shows the lane-stall blocker with the same operator hints as today. Tests assert error messages are operator-readable. The audit log shows the lane_finalization marker so a reviewer can grep it.

jobs.title: Build review gemini adversarial
jobs.objective: Adversarial: (1) an agent that writes the artifact with a forged byline matching expected_author_line — does the runner detect it? (2) a frontmatter that parses but has `verdict_intent: needs_revision` on a review job — does the runner record a `needs_revision` verdict, not silently accept? (3) a race where the agent is still writing the file when the lease-tick fires — does the mtime>10s anti-race actually protect? (4) a feature-flag-off run that somehow still triggers auto-finalize (flag check skipped in error path); (5) an auto-finalize sequence that lands the publish but crashes before complete — does the job state reconcile cleanly?
